subject.title: fix(agents): send session_id affinity header to ChatGPT Responses backend

question: Should OpenClaw accept generating a `session_id` header by default for native ChatGPT Responses requests when no caller header already exists?
rationale: The code path and proof support the fix, but changing default outbound provider headers is compatibility-sensitive and should be an explicit maintainer merge decision.

options.title: Accept Scoped Header
options.body: Land once exact-head CI is green, keeping the header limited to the native chatgpt.com Responses backend and preserving caller-supplied overrides.

options.title: Require Broader Header Parity
options.body: Ask for a follow-up change to align all sibling ChatGPT/Codex affinity headers before merge, trading more wire-surface for stricter parity.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Header
recommendation.body: Land once exact-head CI is green, keeping the header limited to the native chatgpt.com Responses backend and preserving caller-supplied overrides.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest recent ownership signal is provider request policy and OpenAI transport request-shaping work.
